Mike: Quick check — CloudHarbor asked for a shared sandbox for the co-sell POC. Need a concise runbook for tenant provisioning, entitlements, SSO, and example pricing to share with them. They want this up by EOD Wed. Any blockers?
Sarah: On it. Do we have an approved partner-entitlement template? They explicitly asked for 'raw token access' for embeddings during dev.
Elaine: Security red flag: we cannot give prod keys. Offer scoped API keys with narrow scopes + audit logging. They'll also need us to complete the SAML/security questionnaire. Link: https://redwood.internal/qna (private).
Paul: From infra: choices are (A) partner VPC peering, (B) shared sandbox tenant. Need to know egress constraints — they mentioned an on-prem connector so we'll need NAT/egress IPs.
Mike: Also pricing question — how to position Hosted pilot credits vs a short Dedicated eval? They want simple numbers to justify to procurement.
Sarah: For pilots we usually offer 100k free-generation tokens + 2k embed units as a starter. Dedicated quotes depend on GPU sizing; I'll pull a quick ballpark and DM finance.
Elaine: On the questionnaire: Q12 asks "customer-managed KMS?" We support KMS in Private deployments but not in hosted sandboxes. We'll mark "available in Private / Dedicated" and offer mitigation controls (encrypted at rest, RBAC, audit logs).
Paul: SSO blocker: we can't enable SAML until IdP metadata + allowed IPs are provided. Example minimal metadata step for them to export: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.cloudharbor.com">...Metadata...```. Also need their assertion consumer URL.
Mike: Security asked about ephemeral creds — can we issue short-lived tokens instead of static keys for the sandbox? That would make the partner happy.
Paul: Yes — infra can mint time-limited partner tokens via our admin API (example endpoint: POST /admin/partners/{id}/tokens?ttl=3600). Audit logs will capture token usage.
sandbox-bot: sandbox-service: provisioning started for CloudHarbor-sandbox (req=9342). Estimated time ~15m.
Sarah: I'll spin up test accounts once provisioning completes. Elaine — can you put canned answers to the security questionnaire in the shared drive? I can attach those to the partner email.
Elaine: Done — uploaded security_responses_CloudHarbor_v1.pdf and a short note about HSM/KMS tradeoffs. Also flagged SOC2 artifact requests they might ask for.
Mike: Great. I will compile the runbook with these items: entitlement template, time-limited token process, SSO checklist, egress IPs (when Paul posts), and pilot credit/pricing. Target: send to partner tomorrow morning and demo after confirmation. :thumbsup:
Paul: Will post the NAT/egress IP list in this thread once cloud NAT is provisioned — ETA 3pm PST today.
Sarah: If anything else pops up I’ll update here. Thanks team!
